```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

dashboard_machine_library <- file.path(
  path.expand("~/R"),
  paste0(R.version$platform, "-library"),
  paste(R.version$major, sub("\\..*$", "", R.version$minor), sep = ".")
)
if (dir.exists(dashboard_machine_library)) {
  .libPaths(unique(c(.libPaths(), dashboard_machine_library)))
}

required_packages <- c("DBI", "duckdb", "here", "kableExtra")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them in the project renv library before rendering."
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(here)
  library(kableExtra)
})

source(here::here("r_scripts", "lib", "dashboard", "load.R"))

database_path <- dashboard_resolve_database_path(params$database_path)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = database_path,
  read_only = TRUE
)
talent_row <- tryCatch(
  dashboard_select_unified_talent(con, params$talent),
  finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
)

report_data <- dashboard_load_company_analytics(
  database_path = database_path,
  talent_codes = talent_row$talent_code[[1]]
)
df <- report_data$analytics
report_talent_name <- gsub("_", " ", talent_row$talent_name[[1]], fixed = TRUE)

summarize_analytics <- function(analytics_df, talent_name) {
  total_hours <- sum(analytics_df$duration_seconds, na.rm = TRUE) / 3600

  tibble::tibble(
    Talent = talent_name,
    Statistic = c("Total Streamed Hours", "Total Streamed Days", "Total Views"),
    Value = c(
      total_hours,
      total_hours / 24,
      sum(analytics_df$views, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}
```

# Executive Summary

# Introduction

This report summarizes publishing activity and performance for **`r report_talent_name`** using the latest available unified-DuckDB analytics snapshot.

# Summary Analytics

```{r}
#| label: summary-analytics

summary_df <- summarize_analytics(df, report_talent_name)

summary_df %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Summary Analytics",
    col.names = c("Talent", "Metric", "Value"),
    digits = 1
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

# Content Frequency by Month

```{r}
#| label: content-frequency-month

month_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(.data$publish_month, name = "ContentReleases") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$ContentReleases))

month_summary %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Content Frequency by Month",
    col.names = c("Month", "Content Releases")
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

# Content by Topic

```{r}
#| label: content-frequency-topic

topic_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$topic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    TotalCounts = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$`Video ID`),
    TotalSecondsStreamed = sum(.data$duration_seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalSubsGained = sum(.data$subscribersGained, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TotalMinutesStreamed = .data$TotalSecondsStreamed / 60,
    TotalHoursStreamed = .data$TotalMinutesStreamed / 60
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$TotalHoursStreamed))

topic_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TotalHoursStreamed = round(.data$TotalHoursStreamed, 1)) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Content by Classified Topic",
    col.names = c(
      "Topic",
      "Videos / Streams",
      "Seconds Streamed",
      "Subscribers Gained",
      "Minutes Streamed",
      "Hours Streamed"
    )
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

## With Included Reference

```{r}
#| label: content-frequency-reference

reference_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    content_reference = stringr::str_remove(.data$content_reference, "\\s*pt\\.\\d+$")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$topic, .data$content_reference) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    TotalCounts = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$`Video ID`),
    TotalSecondsStreamed = sum(.data$duration_seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalSubsGained = sum(.data$subscribersGained, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TotalMinutesStreamed = .data$TotalSecondsStreamed / 60,
    TotalHoursStreamed = .data$TotalMinutesStreamed / 60
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$TotalHoursStreamed))

reference_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TotalHoursStreamed = round(.data$TotalHoursStreamed, 1)) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Content Summary by Topic and Reference",
    col.names = c(
      "Topic",
      "Reference / Tags",
      "Videos / Streams",
      "Seconds Streamed",
      "Subscribers Gained",
      "Minutes Streamed",
      "Hours Streamed"
    )
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```
